narrative.overview: A calm, dense instrument panel for people who watch many sessions for hours. Neutrals carry the whole interface; color appears only to signal state.
keyCharacteristics: Zinc neutrals for all structure; semantic color for status only.
Small type (11-14px), mono for machine-ish content.
Flat tonal layering with hairline borders; shadows only on floating layers.
Hover-reveal secondary controls; keyboard paths first-class.
Dark and light share one component set via variable inversion.

rules.name: The Status-Only Color Rule
rules.body: Hue means state. If a colored element is not reporting running, waiting, failed, ok or routed model, make it zinc.

rules.name: The Routing Trio Rule
rules.body: Blue, amber and green dots belong to the Model Routing turn indicator only.

rules.name: The Machine-Words-Are-Mono Rule
rules.body: Paths, commands, model ids, tokens, costs and counts use mono.

rules.name: The Flat-At-Rest Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow until it floats above the page.

dos: Do express every neutral through the zinc scale so the light theme's inversion keeps working.
Do keep secondary actions hover-revealed and always reachable by keyboard.
Do use mono for paths, model ids, tokens and costs.
donts: Don't introduce a brand accent color.
Don't add gradients, glows, illustrations or decorative motion.
Don't use shadows on resting surfaces.
Don't hard-code hex or white/black in components.
